sentences.text: MR HM PRACHCHHAK, ADVOCATE for the Applicant(s) No. 1 NOTICE SERVED BY DS for the Respondent(s) No. 2 - 3 MS HB PUNANI, APP. for the Respondent(s) No. 1 ================================================================
ORAL ORDER Heard Mr. H.M.Prachchhak, learned Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Prachchhak pointed out that the Appellate Authority as provided under Section 70 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 is yet to be constituted and the petitioner is rendered remediless.
Considering the said fact, Rule. Ms. H.B.Punani, learned APP. waives notice of rule on behalf of respondent-State.
Ad-interim relief in terms of paragraph 13(B).
Liberty to apply for final hearing after the pleadings are over.

Sd/-
